# init_mat! {#sec-doc}
    

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="docblock" collapse=false}    


```julia
init_mat!(dgp, dist_error, mat)
```
Initialize the data matrix `mat` in-place for a spatial DGP by setting its first row(s) and column(s) to the marginal mean of the process. Methods exist for `SAR11`, `SINAR11` (mean rounded to an integer), and `SAR22` (first two rows/columns).
 
  * `dgp`: spatial DGP (`SAR11`, `SINAR11`, or `SAR22`).
  * `dist_error`: innovation (error) distribution of the process.
  * `mat`: data matrix to initialize.


:::
